Predicates:
MadeBy(x, y) ::: x is made by y.
Game(x) ::: x is a game.
Top10(x) ::: x is in the Top 10 list.
SoldMoreThanOneMillion(x) ::: x sold more than one million copies.
JapaneseCompany(x) ::: x is a Japanese game company.
Name(x, y) ::: x is named y.
Questionally, based on the above, is the following statement true, false, or uncertain? FIFA 22 is made by a Japanese video game company.

Premises:
∀x (Game(x) ∧ MadeBy(x, y) → JapaneseCompany(y)) ::: All games in the Top 10 list are made by Japanese game companies.
∀x (Game(x) ∧ SoldMoreThanOneMillion(x) → Top10(x)) ::: If a game sells more than one million copies, then it will be selected into the Top 10 list.
SoldMoreThanOneMillion(theLegendOfZelda) ::: The Legend of Zelda sold more than one million copies.

Conclusion:
Questionally, based on the above, is the following statement true, false, or uncertain? FIFA 22 is made by a Japanese video game company.
